subject: Intro & Exec Sponsor Request — Peregrine demo
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@peregrine-sys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro & Exec Sponsor Request — Peregrine demo

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro on LinkedIn earlier. We’ve been running a short assessment of inference platforms and would like to schedule a focused demo for the architecture and SLA story. Our CIO (Lena Morales) and VP of Engineering (Tara Hsu) want to join to validate the deployment patterns and compliance posture.

Ideal format: 45 minutes demo + 15 minutes for SLA/ops Q&A. Preferred windows: Dec 20–22, mornings Pacific (8am–11am PT). If you can provide a Redwood exec sponsor (VP/CTO level) to speak to architecture and enterprise readiness that would be great.

Prep: I attached a short requirements snapshot with our latency/retention asks so your team can tailor the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Samuel Ortiz
Sr. Director, Cloud Engineering
Peregrine Systems
Attachment: requirements_snapshot.xlsx (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@peregrine-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & Exec Sponsor Request — Peregrine demo

Hi Samuel — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the snapshot.

We can definitely put senior coverage on this. Lauren Bishop (VP, Solutions) can join as the exec sponsor to walk architecture, integrations, and our SLA guarantees. Marissa will co-own the commercial/contract questions and can cover SLAs if Lauren needs to step out.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Dec 21, 2026 — 09:00–10:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed Dec 22, 2026 — 11:00–12:00 PT (alternate)

If either works, we’ll send a calendar invite and the brief agenda. I’ve attached a short pre-read that maps your requirements to areas we’ll demo. Please let us know which slot you prefer and who will be on the call (Lena/Tara or others).

Next step: Confirm preferred slot and we’ll share the meeting link + agenda.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Samuel — quick note from the commercial side. I’m booked for Dec 21 morning but can hop on for the SLA portion if necessary. Lauren is available and will be the main exec sponsor.

If you want an additional technical deep-dive (deployments, quantization tradeoffs, private cluster checklist) we can schedule a follow-up with our applied ML lead the week after the demo. For now, can you confirm:
- Primary attendees (Lena/Tara + any infra leads)
- Any must-see use-cases from the snapshot (e.g., inference at edge vs centralized)

I’m also attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) so we’re aligned on next steps post-demo.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Thanks — Dec 21, 09:00–10:00 PT works for us. Confirmed attendees so far: Lena Morales (CIO), Tara Hsu (VP Eng), and myself. We may add our lead SRE (Priya Suresh) — I’ll confirm by EOD Dec 17.

Two quick asks:
1) Please include an agenda with timeboxes (we have back-to-back meetings).
2) Share a short dial-in (Google Meet/Zoom) and one pager on SLAs/incident response so our procurement team can pre-review.

Appreciate the MAP — we’ll take a look and suggest any edits. Looking forward to the demo.

Samuel
